generation.method: Deterministic hand-authored fictional records created from an original teaching specification; no external data, fitted distribution, scraped values, model output, or real identifiers were used.

rights.authorship_assertion: The project authors created every byte of the fixture data, metadata, and offline lab payload except the names of open formats, Python/Jupyter, and the linked CC0 legal instrument.
rights.course_code_and_copy: Not covered by this data dedication; governed by the repository and source-specific terms.

lab_pack.authorship: Original course code, schemas, notebook wrapper, templates, and documentation; no external course artifacts copied.
lab_pack.runtime: CPython standard library only; dependency-free notebook cell runner included and optional Jupyter presentation host not bundled.

datasheet.purpose: A small offline fixture for teaching Python execution, arrays, tidy tables, missingness, validation, descriptive statistics, visualization, file formats, and audited joins.
datasheet.unit_of_observation: One fictional learner code in one fictional period; codes do not correspond to people.
datasheet.composition: Eighteen rows across three invented cohorts and two invented periods, plus a three-row cohort lookup.
datasheet.missingness: Two study-minute cells and two checkpoint-score cells are intentionally empty; support_requested includes an explicit unknown category.
datasheet.sensitive_attributes: None. Cohort colors are arbitrary teaching labels and must not be interpreted as demographic, institutional, geographic, or protected groups.
datasheet.maintenance: Immutable. Any byte change requires a new fixture version, new hashes, and a new notice/provenance version.

known_artificialities: The sample is tiny and deliberately balanced enough for manual checking.
Values were selected to create visible but non-empirical differences for grouping, missingness, and chart exercises.
There is no underlying population, intervention, causal process, privacy subject, or live data-collection system.
The rows must never be merged with real records or represented as anonymized observations.
non_claims: No claim about real learners, institutions, educational programs, outcomes, disparities, or effectiveness.
No claim of representativeness, causal identification, privacy compliance, legal authorization, security, fairness, or production readiness.
No claim that structural validation establishes truth, appropriate meaning, or fitness for a consequential decision.
